hooks.text: 角色攻击与特效完全模块化，跑图途中可按局势随时替换。
hooks.excerpt: The player's own attacks and special effects can be exchanged midway through runs as the situation demands, or simply for fun.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三名角色、四档主难度和可自由开关的挑战/降难选项共同支持自定义难度。
hooks.excerpt: There are a lot of ways to approach the game, with three playable characters, four major difficulty options, and a myriad of challenges and difficulty-lowering options that can be enabled or disabled at will.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每种失败都配有专门写作的坏结局笑话，共计 60 个，让失败局也产生叙事回报。
hooks.excerpt: And 60 bad endings uniquely written for every possible loss! Never a run wasted if there's a new dumb joke at the end!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 美术极具个性，并能有力传达剧情情绪。

excerpts.excerpt: the art is incredibly charismatic and conveys the emotion of the plot amazingly well
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 难度曲线后期突然失控。

excerpts.excerpt: 这难度曲线确实有点诡异了，从五面开始初见端倪到七面彻底放飞自我
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 后期存在明显性能问题。

excerpts.excerpt: there are fairly sizable performance issues, especially at the end of the game
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 保留东方弹幕挑战的同时允许夸张多样的角色构筑。

excerpts.excerpt: manages to capture the challenge of the OG shmups while still allowing for wild character builds.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 作为肉鸽本身有大量可享受的玩法要素。

excerpts.excerpt: a perfectly fine rogue-like with plenty of elements to enjoy from strictly a point of view of gameplay.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 多个结局令人高度不满足。
叙事最终留下持续的挫败与不满。

excerpts.excerpt: I walked away with a lingering sense of frustration and dissatisfaction.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 完成真结局带来强烈情感冲击，令人难忘。

excerpts.excerpt: I'm bawling my eyes out having just truly completed the story, a game I will not soon—or never—forget.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: the quality of the writing is genuinely outstanding
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 作品对东方Project的热爱与投入非常鲜明。
